title: The Generous Dealing of Yahya the Barmecide with Mansur
logline: A debtor must find a million dirhams before sunset; the generous Yahya raises it all, adds a famous jewel to win the caliph's mercy, and forgives the frightened man's ungrateful words.
moral: True generosity does not wait for thanks, and it forgives what fear makes people say.
tone: Warm court comedy with a ticking clock: suspense from the hourglass and the sinking sun, humour from the nearly empty strongbox, and a quiet, generous ending.

beats.summary: Caliph Harun gives Salih the order.
A million dirhams before sunset; the hourglass starts.
Mansur has only a sliver of the sum; fear freezes him.
The guard pities him and takes him to Yahya.
Yahya revealed, giving to the needy.
The strongbox holds only 5,000 (and a moth).
Yahya sends to his sons without a pause.
The total passes one million: enough, and more.
Yahya's hope (thought cloud): the caliph will know the jewel and soften.
Mansur, overcome by fear, recites ungrateful verses.
Harun recognises the jewel; the heart Yahya hoped for appears.
Yahya hears of the verses and is not angry.
Generosity that waits for no thanks.

sets.description: The planned palaceHall, full palace variant (1000 x 1230): blue dotted back wall with three pointed arches, open door arch on the left (x 40..250, top y 480) showing the sky, dais x 560..900 top y 860, red runner carpet, checker floor, two lamps, floor y 900. The planned throne stands on the dais at x 730. Needs the option doorSky u so skyCycle shows through the arch (u 0.30 in S1, 0.49 in S13).

The same palaceHall function with variant:'vizierHouse': warm paper and yellow wall with red dot shading instead of blue, no throne; a low cushioned dais (x 600..860, top y 860) with a red bolster, a brass lamp each side (lit flag for night), the same left door arch with doorSky u. One function, one more palette: not a new set.

The planned palaceHall variant merchantHouse: plain wall, small window, door on the left, shelf, tiled floor, low table (x 380..560, top y 800) and a stool at x 640. Kept bare to show Mansur has little.

The planned marketStreet, here at dusk (skyCycle u 0.45): house fronts, one closed stall, a lamp post; made 1600 wide (or tiled) so the camera can track the walkers about 300 units. Long shadows under the figures (flat dark ellipses stretched 2.5x).

props.description: Planned throne: high back 300 with pointed arch, seat 48 above its base, 150 wide.

Planned panel-space time meter (KD-017), drawn top right of the picture panel, 70 x 110 px. Level keys: appears 10.48 at 1.0; 0.8 at 25; 0.55 at 53.6; 0.45 at 60.4; 0.32 at 61.2 (after LATER); 0.2 at 86.2; 0.1 at 104; 0.03 at 128.0, then tick and fade by 129.5; returns empty at 160.26 to tip over and fade. Hidden in the close shots S8, S10, S14, S16.
Planned coin mound with a removable coin; n 6 for Mansur, n 10 in the strongbox, heaped in the sons' chests.

The chest from the planned treasureHoard module: 200 wide, 130 high, hinged lid (open 0..1), fill 0..1 of coins. Three instances: house strongbox (brown, nearly empty), al-Fadl chest (green band), Jaafar chest (red band).
Planned sack with fill 0..1, here 150 wide x 170 high with a round coin mark on the front; stands for the million when carried.

Planned jewels module (AN-086): one large red cut gem, 48 across at s 1 (hexagon with 5 facet lines and a sliding white glint), in a gold casket 80 x 50 with a hinged lid. Always drawn with goldGlow when open. This is the story's key prop: keep its shape and colour identical every time it appears.
Planned small scroll: the runner notes and the verse scroll in the balloons (4 wavy lines, no readable writing).

actions.action: The real Yahya closes his eyes a moment, hand on heart.
actions.acting: lid 1 for 0.6 s, PERSON_HANDS.chest, small smile

actions.action: Cloud Harun's stern brow melts and he smiles.
actions.acting: brow 0.8 to -0.2 over 0.5 s, mouth frown to smile

actions.action: Cloud Mansur, kneeling small on the right, is waved up by Harun and stands, free.

scenes.summary: On the road at dusk, fear gets the better of Mansur: he recites verses that suggest he went to his benefactor only because he was forced to.

camera.notes: Wide on the dusk street (zoom 1.15), tracking right with the walkers (camera x follows their midpoint from 380 to 620); push to a medium on Mansur (zoom 1.7) at 110.0 for the verses; reframe with twoShot to include Salih's face at 115.1.

scenes.composition: Street at skyCycle u 0.45 (dusk), long shadows. The pair walk left to right: Mansur ahead with the sack and casket, Salih a step behind with the chest. Verse balloon rises up left of Mansur's head, clear of both faces. Hourglass top right, nearly empty.

actions.action: Walking in the street, no longer smiling: he keeps glancing back over his shoulder.
actions.acting: walk(); gaze flicks back and up to the low sun (saccades), brow -0.6

actions.action: Slows; the sack droops in his arms.
actions.acting: walk amp falls with speed, sq 0.96, lid 0.4

actions.action: A small dark cloud with the barred window icon follows above his head.
actions.acting: reuses the prison bars picture from S2 at half size, bobbing on K.noise

actions.action: Shivers; sweat drop; his eyes go wet.
actions.acting: tremble(t, 2.5), wet true, one sweat drop only

actions.action: Lifts his chin and one hand and begins to recite.
actions.acting: anticipate breath in (sq 1.04), PERSON_HANDS.pointUp softened to a raised open hand, talk 0.8 in a sing song rhythm

actions.action: The street slides by: a stall and a lamp post pass behind them.
actions.acting: parallax from the camera track; shadows lengthen

actions.action: A verse balloon rises from his mouth: a small scroll with four wavy lines in two pairs (no readable text) and two quaver notes.
actions.acting: lines draw on one by one, 0.25 s apart, in time with talk

actions.action: Inside the balloon the picture changes: a tiny Yahya portrait with a heart, and the heart cracks.
actions.acting: crack line draws on in 0.2 s; the heart halves slip 4 px
actions.library: heart (Library) with a zigzag crack overlay

actions.action: Balloon picture: a tiny Mansur pushed toward Yahya's door by a big pointing hand.
actions.acting: the hand shoves twice; the figure slides, heels dug in

actions.action: Behind him Salih stops dead; his head turns to Mansur.
actions.acting: footfall stop with landSquash, gaze snaps to Mansur, brow -0.5 (disbelief)

actions.action: Finishes with a shrug, palms up: only because I had to.
actions.acting: PERSON_HANDS.palmsUp shrug, gaze away from Salih, lid 0.5; balloon label ONLY BECAUSE I HAD TO

scenes.summary: Salih rebukes him: a poor reward for the man who saved him from ruin.

camera.notes: twoShot(salih, mansur, {margin 110}) zoom 1.6, both faces in frame throughout; slow push to 1.8 by 122.8.

scenes.composition: Salih left (x 400) facing right, Mansur right (x 620) turned back toward him. The verse balloon is knocked away upper right. Memory inset of Yahya appears top centre between and above the heads.

actions.action: Sets the chest down hard and plants the spear.
actions.acting: chest impactSquash, dust; brow 0.9, mouth open

actions.action: Swats the verse balloon: it pops into paper bits.
actions.acting: arm swipe aR, balloon bursts into 8 seeded scraps that fall with fallY

actions.action: Flinches and hugs the sack; shrinks.
actions.acting: sq 0.92, tip -0.1 away, eyes wide then down

actions.action: Wags a finger in Mansur's face.
actions.acting: PERSON_HANDS.pointFwd with 3 wags, talk 0.9, brow 0.9, tip 0.08

actions.action: Balloon from Salih: Yahya's open giving hand, answered by a thumbs down.
actions.acting: two frames pop 0.3 s apart

actions.action: SHAME! in red beside Salih, clear of both faces.
actions.acting: emphasis pop with a 2 frame shake inside the panel only

actions.action: Memory inset: Yahya handing over the casket, exactly the S8 pose.
actions.acting: iris opens with dream wash; Salih points up at it
actions.library: inset circle replaying the S8 pose (setup and payoff)

actions.action: Looks up at the inset, then his eyes break away and his head drops.
actions.acting: shame ending pattern: gaze to inset 0.5 s, then down, lid 0.7, head drop 10 px

actions.action: Picks the chest up again, shakes his head and walks on; Mansur follows two steps behind now.
actions.acting: walk() right; order reversed from S11 (Salih leads), Mansur trails with small steps

scenes.summary: Back before the caliph just in time, Salih presents the money and the jewel, and also reports what Mansur said.

camera.notes: Wide on the palace hall (zoom 1.05) as they enter; ease to the two-shot of Harun and Salih (zoom 1.45) by 131.6; Mansur stays in frame at the left edge.

scenes.composition: Same blocking as S1 so the pictures rhyme: Harun on the throne (x 730), Salih at x 400, now with the chest and sack laid on the red runner at x 520 and the casket on top. Mansur stands back at x 200 by the arch, head low. Through the arch the sun sits on the horizon (u 0.49).

actions.action: Strides in and lays the chest and sack before the throne; kneels on one knee and lifts the casket in both hands.
actions.acting: walk(), impactSquash on the chest, kneel 0.6, handLW/handRW raise the casket above head height (use aL/aR angles for the read)

actions.action: The last grain hangs in the hourglass: it freezes, gets a tick mark and fades away.
actions.acting: pulse then alpha 1 to 0 by 129.5

actions.action: Looks down at the heap; one eyebrow rises.
actions.acting: gaze to the chest, brow -0.4, lid 0.2

actions.action: The chest lid opens: coins; the counter 1,000,000 stamps PAID.
actions.acting: lid overshoot, glints; counter appears for 1.5 s only

actions.action: The casket opens in Salih's raised hands: the red jewel lights the hall.
actions.acting: goldGlow 0 to 0.8; red tint on Harun face; Harun pupils snap to it and hold (anticipation of S14)

actions.action: Stands, leans in and speaks behind his hand.
actions.acting: kneel to stand, PERSON_HANDS.cupMouth, talk 0.6; gaze slides once to Mansur

actions.action: Icon balloon from Salih: tiny Mansur reciting, the verse scroll and the cracked heart.
actions.acting: reuses the S11 balloon pictures at small size, 2 frames 0.35 s apart

actions.action: By the arch Mansur shrinks, hands clasped, eyes on the floor; Harun frowns at him for a beat.
actions.acting: sq 0.93, lid 0.6, tremble 1; Harun gaze to Mansur with brow 0.7, then back toward the jewel

scenes.summary: Harun recognises the jewel, is moved by Yahya's generosity, and sends it back to him.

camera.notes: Close on Harun and the casket (x 690, y 650, zoom 2.1), push to 2.4 by 139.9; pull back to zoom 1.5 at 140.8 for the return.

scenes.composition: Harun has taken the casket into his lap; his face upper centre, the jewel lower left of it. The memory inset from S8 flashes top left. The red frown of S1 and S2 is replaced by a soft face.

actions.action: Takes the casket and stares: he knows it.
actions.acting: eyes wide, brow -0.7, head forward 6 px; a "!" pops

actions.action: The S8 memory inset flashes: the same jewel on his own turban.
actions.acting: iris open 0.2 s, hold 0.8 s, shut; arrow from the inset jewel to the real one

actions.action: The jewel glows; a tiny Yahya portrait appears in its glint.
actions.acting: goldGlow pulse; label YAHYA'S GIFT

actions.action: His eyes fill; hand goes to his heart.
actions.acting: wet true, lid 0.3, brow -0.3, long blink, PERSON_HANDS.chest

actions.action: A heart pops on his chest, the same heart Yahya hoped for in his thought cloud.
actions.acting: identical size and place to the S10 cloud heart (payoff)

actions.action: Closes the casket gently and holds it out to Salih, pointing back the way they came.
actions.acting: anticipate, handRW out with the casket, PERSON_HANDS.pointFwd left with the other hand, mouth smile

actions.action: Receives it with a bow and hurries out by the arch; Harun waves Mansur free with a flick of the hand.
actions.acting: tip 0.2 bow, turnFlip, walk(); Mansur lifts his head, stunned

scenes.summary: At night the jewel comes home to Yahya, and with it the news of what Mansur said after being helped.

camera.notes: Two-shot in Yahya's hall at night (x 600, y 690, zoom 1.5). Static: only the two figures act.

scenes.composition: Lamps lit, the arch shows the night sky (u 0.72, moon). Yahya stands at x 700; Salih at x 480 holds out the casket.

actions.action: Places the casket back in Yahya's hands.
actions.acting: handRW to Yahya hands, bow tip 0.15

actions.action: Looks at the jewel, surprised and then glad: his hope worked.
actions.acting: brow -0.5 then smile, red glint on his face

actions.action: Hesitates, then speaks behind his hand.
actions.acting: gaze down first (reluctant), PERSON_HANDS.cupMouth, talk 0.5

actions.action: The small balloon again: Mansur reciting, the cracked heart.
actions.acting: same pictures as S13, pops 0.3 s

actions.action: His smile stops. He looks at the balloon, very still; only his pupils move.
actions.acting: suspense by stillness: no body motion, gaze balloon then floor, lid 0.3; Salih watches him, bracing for anger

scenes.summary: Yahya is not angry. Fear and sorrow, he says, can make a person say what he does not mean.

camera.notes: Close on Yahya (x 700, y 650, zoom 2.0) with a slow push to 2.25; at 153.8 ease out to zoom 1.5 so the two small icons beside him and Salih's reaction are in frame.

scenes.composition: Yahya upper centre. The balloon with the cracked heart floats left of his head; he mends it. Icons FEAR (the barred window cloud) and SORROW (a tear drop) appear left, at eye height, with a small Mansur under them.

actions.action: A breath in, eyes closed. Salih waits for the storm.
actions.acting: lid 1 for 0.8 s, sq 1.03 inhale then release; Salih brow -0.5

actions.action: Opens his eyes and smiles gently; shakes his head.
actions.acting: lid to 0.15, mouth smile, brow -0.2, small head shake (gaze x swing twice)

actions.action: He reaches up and pinches the cracked heart in the balloon back together; the crack disappears.
actions.acting: handRW to the balloon, the two halves close with a small overshoot

actions.action: Raises a teaching finger and speaks.
actions.acting: PERSON_HANDS.pointUp, talk 0.7, gaze to Salih

actions.action: Icon FEAR pops: the dark cloud with the barred window, over a small trembling Mansur.
actions.acting: pop with overshoot; small Mansur tremble 2

actions.action: Icon SORROW pops beside it: a big tear drop.
actions.acting: pop 4 frames later; the small Mansur gets wet eyes

actions.action: Both icons press down on the small Mansur: he squashes.
actions.acting: sq 1 to 0.8, arrows from the icons down to him

actions.action: Out of the small Mansur's mouth squeezes the little verse scroll.
actions.acting: scroll pops out with a squeak stretch; he looks at it, surprised himself

actions.action: Salih's jaw drops, then he bows his head to Yahya in respect.
actions.acting: mouth o, brow -0.6, then tip 0.2 bow with lid 1; Yahya pats his shoulder

scenes.summary: The ordeal is over. At dawn Mansur walks free, and Yahya goes on giving, asking for no thanks. THE END.

camera.notes: Start medium on Yahya at the door arch (zoom 1.5) and pull out slowly to the full hall (zoom 1.05) by 164.3; hold for THE END.

scenes.composition: Dawn through the arch (skyCycle u 1.0 to 0.08). Mansur passes outside the arch left to right, free, without the sack. Yahya back on his cushion at x 700; the old woman and villager from S4 return at x 470 and x 380, so the film closes on the picture it opened Yahya with. THE END title in the upper third, clear of all faces.

actions.action: Night turns to dawn in the arch: stars fade, the sky goes yellow.
actions.acting: skyCycle u 0.72 to 1.0 in 1.2 s

actions.action: The empty hourglass tips over on its side and fades; the barred window icon cracks and falls apart.
actions.acting: rot 0 to 1.57 with rebound, alpha out; bars drop with fallY

actions.action: Seen through the arch, Mansur walks by outside in the morning light, stretches his arms and breathes out.
actions.acting: walk() slow, aL/aR raised stretch, sq 1.05 then settle; he pauses, looks in toward Yahya, hand on heart, and walks on

actions.action: Sits back down on his cushion, the casket set aside, closed.
actions.acting: sit 0 to 1 with landSquash, breathe(); calm face

actions.action: The old woman and the villager come in again by the arch.
actions.acting: walk() in, out of step; Yahya gaze lifts and he smiles

actions.action: Holds out a purse to the next person in need.
actions.acting: handRW with the purse, anticipate draw back first (same move as S4)

actions.action: A soft gold glow and one heart rise over Yahya.
actions.acting: goldGlow 0.5, heart overshoot

actions.action: The villager starts a deep bow of thanks; Yahya waves it away, smiling, already turning to the next.
actions.acting: PERSON_HANDS.wave low, small head shake; gaze to the old woman

actions.action: Camera settles on the wide hall; everyone holds a living pose (breathing, blinks).

actions.action: THE END pops in the upper third with a halftone burst and holds to the end of the film.
actions.acting: title overshoot 0.3 s; Yahya one slow blink at 169.5; the heart fades by 170.5

ending.description: Dawn in Yahya's hall. Mansur has walked free past the arch; Yahya sits giving a purse to the same needy visitors as in S4 and waves away their thanks. THE END pops at 168.3 in the upper third and holds to 171.24 with everyone breathing and blinking.

subtitles.ar: أمر الخليفة هارون الرشيد أحد حراسه، واسمه صالح،|أن يأخذ من رجل يدعى منصور مليون درهم قبل غروب الشمس.|وقال إن لم يدفع المال في الوقت المحدد، فسيعاقب عقابًا شديدًا.
subtitles.en: Caliph Harun ordered his guard Salih|to collect a million dirhams from Mansur before sunset,|threatening severe punishment if the money did not arrive.

subtitles.ar: لم يكن لدى منصور إلا جزء صغير من المبلغ،|فاشتد خوفه وعجز عن التفكير.|رق له صالح، واصطحبه إلى بيت يحيى بن خالد البرمكي،|الذي اشتهر بكرمه ومساعدة المحتاجين.
subtitles.en: Mansur possessed only a small part of the sum.|Seeing his distress,|Salih took him to Yahya ibn Khalid al-Barmaki,|a man renowned for generosity.

subtitles.ar: سمع يحيى القصة،|وطلب من خازنه أن يحضر ما عنده من نقود.|لم يجد في الخزانة إلا خمسة آلاف درهم،|فبعث يطلب العون من ابنيه الفضل وجعفر دون تأخير.
subtitles.en: Yahya heard the story|and checked his treasury,|finding only five thousand dirhams.|He immediately asked his sons al-Fadl and Jaafar for help.

subtitles.ar: أرسل كل واحد من الابنين مبلغًا كبيرًا،|فصار لدى يحيى ما يكفي لسداد الدين وزيادة.|وأضاف إلى المال جوهرة نفيسة كان لها تاريخ معروف في مجلس الخليفة،|وسلم الجميع إلى منصور.
subtitles.en: Each son sent a large sum,|enough to cover the debt and more.|Yahya added a valuable jewel familiar at the caliph’s court|and handed everything to Mansur.

subtitles.ar: شكر منصور يحيى،|ثم خرج مع صالح يحمل المال والجوهرة.|وكان يحيى يأمل أن يتعرف الخليفة إلى الجوهرة،|فيدرك مقدار المساعدة التي قدمها، فيلين قلبه تجاه الرجل المديون.
subtitles.en: Mansur thanked Yahya|and departed with Salih.|Yahya hoped the caliph would recognize the jewel,|understand his generosity, and show mercy to the debtor.

subtitles.ar: لكن منصور، وقد غلبه الخوف،|أنشد في الطريق أبياتًا أوحت بأنه لم يلجأ إلى المحسن إلا مضطرًا.|استنكر صالح كلامه،|وقال إن هذا جزاء سيئ لمن أنقذه من الهلاك.
subtitles.en: Yet on the way|Mansur recited verses suggesting he had sought help only from fear.|Salih rebuked him|for such ingratitude toward the man who had saved him.

subtitles.ar: رفع صالح إلى الخليفة المال والجوهرة، وأخبره كذلك بما قاله منصور.|عرف هارون الجوهرة،|وتأثر بكرم يحيى،|فأعادها إليه. وبلغ يحيى أيضًا خبر كلام الرجل بعد أن ساعده.
subtitles.en: Salih presented the money and jewel and reported Mansur’s words.|Harun recognized the jewel,|was moved by Yahya’s kindness,|and returned it to him.

subtitles.ar: لم يغضب يحيى من منصور،|بل قال إن الخوف والحزن قد يجعلان الإنسان يقول ما لا يريد.|وهكذا انتهت المحنة،|وبقي موقف يحيى شاهدًا على كرم لا ينتظر الشكر.
subtitles.en: Yahya did not resent Mansur.|He said fear and sorrow can make a person speak badly.|The crisis ended,|and his generosity stood without any demand for gratitude.

owner_questions: The "severe punishment" is shown only as an icon (a barred prison window with a chain), never as violence; default: keep it as the prison icon.
The sons al-Fadl and Jaafar appear only as small inset portraits while runners carry notes and chests; default: insets, no separate scenes or sets for them.

The recited verses are shown as a scroll with wavy lines plus pictures (a cracked heart, a figure being pushed) and the short English label ONLY BECAUSE I HAD TO, with no invented Arabic verse text; default: no verse text.
Added comic touches not in the script: a moth flying out of the nearly empty strongbox and the labels ONLY 5,000!, ENOUGH!, AND MORE!, PAID!, SHAME!; default: keep them.
An hourglass meter stands for "before sunset" together with the sun sinking in the door arch; default: use both.
The jewel is shown in a memory inset on the caliph's own turban to explain "a known history at the caliph's court"; default: keep this invented detail.
The ending returns to Yahya giving to the needy at dawn while Mansur walks free past the door, without Mansur apologising (the script has no apology); default: no apology scene.

The Arabic of paragraph 7 ends with a sentence (the news reached Yahya) that the English translation leaves out, so the last English chunk "and returned it to him." sits under that Arabic chunk; default: keep the supplied English unchanged.
implementation_notes: All human figures are the Library person with costume presets; only the soldier preset is new. Set LIFE.t = t each frame so everyone blinks; add hand blinks where a lid is set.
Blocking rhyme: S1 and S13 use the same camera and positions in palaceHall; S4 and S17 use the same positions in yahyaHall. Reuse the pose functions.

Setup and payoff: the jewel (S8) returns identical in S10, S13, S14, S15; the heart on cloud Harun at 101.48 must match the real heart at 139.14 in size and place relative to the figure; the giving pose at 79.76 is replayed in the inset at 123.74.
Seated figures: Harun uses sit:1, seat:'bench' at the throne seat (throne base y 860, seat 48 up); Yahya the same on the cushion dais. Scene draws throne and cushion.
Carrying: sack and casket are scene drawn at the midpoint of handLW/handRW; add kick(t, FALLS) squash on each footfall so the load has weight.
Counters use the style counter primitive; keep them top left or top centre, never over a face. Format with commas: 1,000,000 and 5,000.
The whip at 33.42 and the LATER card at 60.8 hide set or time changes with a camera key pair 0.01 s apart at the covered midpoint.
Sound: only four quiet effects (chime 44.25, whoosh 60.75, chime 71.65, chime 168.5), all in listed pauses or after the last word; master 0.6.
Panel-only shake for SHAME! at 122.84 and the 1,000,000 flash at 68.78; the caption panel never moves.
Lettering diet: name labels once each (CALIPH HARUN, SALIH, MANSUR, YAHYA THE BARMECIDE, TREASURER, AL-FADL, JAAFAR) plus about 12 short words; none may cover a face.
warnings: The word رق (29.86) has an interpolated time in the timeline (it shares 29.86 with له); the softening of Salih may need a nudge of up to 0.3 s after listening.
Only three pauses of 0.6 s or more exist, so the film is almost silent apart from the narration: the comedy and suspense must read without sound.

palaceHall, marketStreet, the soldier preset and most props are planned assets that do not exist in Library yet; if another film builds them first, use those functions and only add the options listed here (variant vizierHouse, doorSky).
Eleven cast ids, but only four act at length (Harun, Salih, Mansur, Yahya); the rest are unchanged presets on screen for a few seconds each.
The person figure is front facing with no profile: for walking left or right rely on dir, gaze and tip; for the whisper use cupMouth and gaze rather than a turned head.
S10 thought cloud figures must stay at least 110 px tall on screen (scale 0.5 at camera zoom 1.3 gives about 150 px).
